hero_summary.headline: Your social energy is more inward, and is more suitable for expansion in a low-noise, high-independence rhythm.
hero_summary.body_core: You’re not necessarily less social, but you’re less reliant on high-frequency interactions for energy, and more need to retain space for solitude and observation.

domains_overview.snapshot_line: When extroversion is low, your advantage is to refrain from entering and observing deeply, at the expense of external expression that may lag behind.

domain_deep_dive.definition: Extraversion reflects the extent to which you derive energy from interaction, expression, stimulation, and external activities.
strengths: It’s not easy to be pushed away by the atmosphere of the context
Ideal for deep processing and low-distraction work
costs: Needs and boundaries may be expressed late
High-frequency social networking is easier to consume
Opportunities sometimes need to be externalized more actively
domain_deep_dive.daily_life: You tend to make your judgment internally before deciding whether to enter the context or express your opinion.

core_portrait.identity: Your energy system is more inward and self-regulating.
core_portrait.default_style: You need to be quiet and autonomous enough to turn observations into stable output.

norms_comparison.relative_meaning: In the reference sample, your extraversion was relatively low, indicating that high-stimulation interactions are not your default recharge mode.

action_plan.priority_hint: Your actions focus on reducing the cost of expression and bringing key feelings and boundaries to the outside earlier and more clearly.

hero_summary.headline: Your social energy is in the middle. You can enter into interactions, but you need to maintain your own rhythm.
hero_summary.body_core: You can express and connect in the right context, but you don’t always gain momentum through excitement, exposure, or high-frequency social interaction.

domains_overview.snapshot_line: At mid-level Extraversion, you can switch between interaction and solitude, but you need to identify which situations are truly energy-filling.

domain_deep_dive.definition: Extraversion determines your natural need for interaction, expression, group stimulation, outpouring of action, and social feedback.
strengths: Can also retain independent processing space
Suitable for switching between speaking and listening
costs: Too many highly stimulating contexts will make you tired
Low interaction contexts that last too long will reduce feedback
Expression intensity is affected by the sense of security in the context
domain_deep_dive.daily_life: Instead of maintaining the same social pattern all the time, you decide how outgoing you are based on the person, the task, and the current situation.

core_portrait.identity: Your energy system is both interactive and adducting.
core_portrait.default_style: You need both connection and space to get back into your own rhythm.

norms_comparison.relative_meaning: In the reference sample, your extraversion is close to the middle, indicating that social drive is not extremely high or extremely low, but is more regulated by the context.

action_plan.priority_hint: Your actions focus on identifying which interactions are valuable and preserving windows of expression for key relationships and key opportunities.

hero_summary.headline: Your social energy is outward and easier to activate through interaction, expression and on-the-spot feedback.
hero_summary.body_core: You are generally more willing to enter a context, initiate connections, speak out your thoughts, and gain a sense of advancement from external feedback.

domains_overview.snapshot_line: When extraversion is high, your advantage is externalization and driving. At the cost, you need to pay attention to excessive rhythm and stimulus overload.

domain_deep_dive.definition: Extraversion reflects the need for interaction, drive for expression, outward action, activity, and intensity of response to external stimuli.
strengths: On-site feedback can increase action energy
costs: May have difficulty tolerating low-feedback environments
Need to avoid masking real fatigue with more interactions
domain_deep_dive.daily_life: You often find the status and direction faster after speaking out, meeting people, and entering the context.

core_portrait.identity: Your energy system is more outward and feedback driven.
core_portrait.default_style: You will activate yourself through expression, connection, and action, and you will also need to schedule time for true noise reduction.

norms_comparison.relative_meaning: In the reference sample, your extraversion is more prominent, indicating that interaction and external feedback are more likely to become your natural motivation.

action_plan.priority_hint: Your focus will be on leveraging your expressive strengths to move key issues forward while leaving boundaries for deep work and recovery.
